messages:
Mike (Support): FYI @Sophie — MiroTech trial flagged as high churn risk. Onboarding is blocked: SSO provisioning returns 403 + embeddings appear low-quality for a subset of documents. Trial ends in 9 days. Customer is considering pause. Logs attached: https://redwood.inc/attachments/4992356789/logs.png :warning:
Sophie (CS Manager): Thanks Mike. Can you paste repro steps and any recent config changes? Marking this P1 for renewals. @Eliza can you help prep an enablement checklist and draft the comms? We need a clear customer-facing mitigation and an internal ops plan. :eyes:
Mike (Support): Repro steps: 1) create trial org -> 2) connect IdP -> 3) POST /provision -> 403 with body `{"error":"forbidden","code":"tenant-disabled"}`. Hit this for 3 different users across 2 regions. No tenant status flips from support side. Embedding issue: low cosine scores vs expected; model = rwd-open-embed-v1-quant. Screenshot + small sample: https://redwood.inc/attachments/4992356789/sample.json
Jordan (SE): :eyes: I can take owner. Quick note: we've seen tenant flag race in the admin service before. Temporary mitigation is an admin patch: `PATCH /admin/tenants/<tenant_id> {"status":"active"}` — needs platform-owner approval. For embeddings, rolling back quant profile to fq128 restored expected sims in QA last week. I will validate impact matrix and rollback steps.
Sophie (CS Manager): Good. We should not do admin-level changes without customer sign-off. Eliza — please draft a customer email that: 1) acknowledges the blockage, 2) offers the temporary workaround and risks, 3) proposes a 30-min enablement session and timeline, 4) promises a root-cause update within 72h. I'll schedule a call for tomorrow 10am PT and loop AM/Finance if they ask for credits.
Eliza (Solutions): Draft ready, posting below and will DM a polished copy. Proposed subject: "Redwood: Next steps for MiroTech onboarding — immediate mitigation + enablement session". Bullets: - brief summary - immediate steps (admin-unblock + how to join call) - embedding revert instructions (config snippet) - meeting link + CS owner contact. Doc refs: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/ssoprovisioning and https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/quant-profiles
Mike (Support): Invite sent to mirotech@mirotech.com and internal calendar. Incident created: INC-2026-345. @incident-bot please attach runbook and assign owner. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Created INC-2026-345, owner: Jordan (SE), runbook: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-345. SLA targets: workaround within 24h, root cause within 72h.
Sophie (CS Manager): Action items summary: Mike — list all affected tenant ids + sample user ids; Jordan — validate admin-change risk, provide rollback plan and a short ETA; Eliza — send customer email draft and enablement deck; I'll monitor account health and prepare renewal engagement if usage drops. Please keep updates concise in-thread. Thanks everyone. :pray:
